notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Features:
Added dialogue setting menu to the in-game menu.
Added audio setting menu to the in-game menu.
Add a new affection system and updated the rookie menu to display it.
Better keyboard support for combat.

Changes:
Affection gain by talking is no longer based only on charm.
4 stats replace default charm bonus. Each stat bonus will correspond to your answer. Charm, smart, badass and general yields different rewards based on your level in them.
Combat keyboard controls: normal speed doubled.
Combat Keyboard controls: Space bar now slows down your speed so you can dodge bullet easier.

Fixes:
Fixed intro skill pop lock up.
Fixed int challenge lock up.
Fixed shop intro lock up.
Mouse cursor image is no longer displayed if you selected keyboard option in combat.
Combat movement lag improved.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 is out now
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979563/f02f25f49f764dfb8fe20cd51f3ae24db20c397d.png
Features:

"Gift helper" submenu added to girls profile.
Type text speed can be changed in the setting menu.

Changes:
[olist]
Mini-games:

Dex targeting epic level mini-games has more chances now.
Poise: increased block minimum size per level and slowed down acceleration between bounces.

Ancient weapon boss:

Slowed down the large energy blasts.
Remove the extra bullet on the beam attack.

Save system

Now autosaves after every story events
If you exit planet or Date location it will return you to that location when you continue.

[/olist]
Bug fixes:

Costume menu bug.
Cleaned up memory leaks.
Achievement - full powerup wasn't activating properly.
Optimization in regards to unloading unnecessary textures.
Win32 build combat cursor bug - now the cursor is lock into the window when combat is active. 
Inventory full zero feedback on trying to buy items - now you can by a fighter even if your inventory is full and there is also a new line for each girl calling you a hoarder.
